text:
sara: Quick sync — we need a final MVP cutlist and escrow rules. We're out of runway for features that risk the milestone. Brief takes?

alex: propose: ship model-pinning + embeddings cache (canary). Escrow tenant SSO and in-console evals behind flags with clear graduation criteria.

ravi: agree. Embeddings cache is low-effort, big unit-economy upside. I'll implement behind a feature flag and a 10% canary.

maggie: sales note: if we escrow evals, we must include a pilot sign-up in the pitch and a "v1" promise slide. Otherwise demos sound hollow.

ben: ops-risk lens: any escrowed feature needs an automated kill-switch and a defined rollback SLA. If it flaps we lose confidence.

nina: QA reminder: define a short, repeatable graduation test (24–48h canary with perf and error gates). QA will run it if dev owners supply the scenarios.

sara: sounds like consensus. Drafting escrow rules: 1) feature behind flag + 5–10% canary, 2) graduation if 48h canary meets perf (p95 <= baseline*1.2) and error-rate <0.5%, 3) auto-disable on 99p latency spike or error-rate >1% for 10m, 4) owner must provide rollout + rollback commands in PR.

alex: adding the auto-disable hook to the PR template. Also add metric names: cache_hit_rate, tokens_saved, latency_p95, error_rate.

ravi: will wire metrics to the dashboard and create alert rules.

maggie: I'll update the deck and add the pilot CTA. Sales to be informed: don't promise SSO or evals for GA.

ben: ops will provide the kill-switch lambda and a short runbook. SLA for manual rollback: 15m once alerted.

nina: QA will prepare the graduation checklist and smoke tests; need dev scenarios by EOD tomorrow.

sara: timeline: milestone freeze in 7 days. Need engineering sign-off on escrow PRs in 48h or features are dropped. PM will publish the cutlist when signoffs are complete.

deploy-bot: Reminder: milestone freeze in 7 days. Link: https://redwood-internal/boards/launch-2951300000

sara: Action items summary — (1) ravi + alex: feature flags + canary + metrics (48h), (2) ben: kill-switch + runbook (2d), (3) nina: QA checklist (48h), (4) maggie: sales + deck update (24h). Please ack in thread.

alex: acked.

ravi: acked.

sara: thanks — I'll lock the cutlist after signoffs. :white_check_mark:
